title: Four copper-alloy wire annealing chambers served by one fork charging car
summary: One car loads and unloads Suneng’s four independently controlled annealing chambers. There is one loading and one unloading station. The maximum charge per chamber is 5.5 tonnes including coils and rack.
seoTitle: Four copper-wire annealing chambers with one charging car
seoDescription: Four 200 kW chambers share one fork car. See rack loading, transfer and unloading duties for a gross load of 5.5 tonnes including the rack.

forkReview.note: Each chamber has one temperature zone. A shared fork car connects the separate loading and unloading stations outside the chambers.
features: The rack enters the designated chamber. Each chamber has its own heating zone. While one is being loaded or unloaded, the others can continue heating or soaking.
Incoming coils wait at the loading station. Annealed coils go to the unloading station. The contract lists one car for the four chambers and both stations.

stages.title: Prepare coils at the loading station
stages.note: The buyer provides the rack. The loaded rack waits at the loading station.

stages.title: Transfer the rack
stages.note: The shared fork car takes the rack to the designated chamber.

stages.title: Anneal in separate chambers
stages.note: Each of the four chambers has one zone for heating and soaking.

stages.title: Receive the rack at the unloading station
stages.note: The fork car retrieves the rack and moves it to the separate unloading station.

head: Item

cards.title: Supply responsibilities
definitions: Designs, manufactures, installs and commissions the system. The contract includes a nine-point temperature instrument for checking differences within the working zone.
Supplies the racks that enter with the coils and loads them under the supplier’s guidance during commissioning.

cards.title: Scope of supply
paragraphs: Each chamber has its own hot-air circulation system and temperature control. One car travels between the loading station, chambers and unloading station.

cards.title: Acceptance procedure
definitions: The contract separates the empty functional check from the loaded test with workpieces and racks.
The contract specifies 30 consecutive days of normal operation. Both parties then conduct acceptance under its technical and acceptance terms.

figure.alt: Four chambers share one charging car
figure.caption: Put the coils on the buyer’s rack. The charging car takes the loaded rack to a chamber. Each chamber has 200 kW of heating. All four share the same car. The car retrieves the annealed rack. Plan transfers against availability of the separate unloading station.

related: Can four wire annealing chambers share a single fork car?
forkReview.faqIntro: Power per chamber, gross charge including racks and the four-chamber handling route.
faq: Does 200 kW per chamber mean 200 kW for the whole system?
200 kW is the heating power of one chamber. There are four chambers, each with one zone.
Does the 5.5-tonne batch include the rack?
Yes. Deduct the actual rack weight from the combined coil-and-rack weight to obtain the net copper charge.
Is there a car for each chamber?
One car serves all four. It takes a rack from the loading station to the designated chamber and moves the annealed batch to the unloading station.
